Service Name

Syntax
Std_ReturnType E2E_P04Forward (
const E2E_P04ConfigType* ConfigPtr,
uint16 Length,
E2E_PCheckStatusType ForwardStatus,
E2E_P04ProtectStateType* StatePtr,
uint8* DataPtr
)

0x33
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
ConfigPtr
Pointer to static configuration.
Length
Length of the data in bytes.
Parameters (in)
ForwardStatus
E2E Status of the received message

Pointer to port/data communication state.
Parameters (inout)
